description: List accounts (companies). Optional search on name, label (name or id: only accounts with this label), stale_days (last activity older than N days), order_by: last_activity|name|created (default last_activity). Returns last_activity_at and labels[].

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

stale_days.description: Only accounts whose last activity is older than this many days

name: list_accounts
